svg.text: Four processes and two origins in dev; one process and one origin in production
declared as a static remote, dev only
edit + save → live HMR patch, no reload
a few seconds, still no manual refresh
Two origins, so the dev CORS policy is exercised.
Extension A never goes through the backend in dev.
It is the only declarative remote, and only here.
npm install + npm run build in host, extension-a, extension-b
built with no remotes declared: nothing is declarative here
every folder under src/extensions is picked up automatically
one origin; every extension discovered at runtime
Single origin, so CORS is never exercised.
